scope_decision: Both complete coherent architectures cover native and deferred captured output ownership at the hardware-input boundary. Full-image reuse requires complete timed row history, sprites/status and live palettes, not frame-end VRAM equality or skipped guest work. Current-value identity still derives geometry/name/pattern inputs and adds command materialization/comparison/memory traffic to an already packed renderer. After two unsuccessful architectures, stop this bounded opportunity; no claim every future algorithm is impossible.
